metadata.note: All names, bank rows, conversations and amounts are invented for the demo. No real banking connection, sending or payment has occurred.
metadata.independence: Each sample contains its complete isolated input. Do not share mutable state or feed gold labels to the matcher.
metadata.syntheticEvidence: Receipt hashes, dimensions and source=ai/manual fields are invented routing fixtures, not uploaded files or real OCR/model results.
metadata.invalidGuard: Case 025 directly tests the internal matcher fail-closed guard. An HTTP request carrying a zero amount must fail schema validation with 422 before the matcher.
metadata.normalization: reference: Unicode NFKC, trim, uppercase, remove Unicode whitespace; retain punctuation. Payer uses independently maintained customer aliases.
metadata.dateWindow: Receipt transfer MYT date through plus 2 calendar days inclusive. A known matching reference outside the window needs review; it is not proof of missing bank funds.
